items.heading: Papa with Moroho
details: Key ingredients: corn meal, water, leafy greens, tomato
Cook corn meal with water into a thick, stiff porridge (papa).
Simmer leafy greens with tomato and onion until tender.
Season the greens well and cook until soft.
Serve the papa alongside the greens.

items.heading: Sesotho Beef Stew
details: Key ingredients: beef, onion, tomato, potato
Brown beef chunks with onion.
Add tomato and potato, then enough water to simmer.
Cook slowly until the beef is very tender.
Serve the stew over papa or rice.
